title: Chaos Engineering
prereqs: Optional: Chaos Mesh for the experiment-CR challenge
description: Break your system on purpose, safely: steady-state hypotheses & blast-radius control, failure injection (pods, processes), network chaos (latency/loss/partition), resource chaos, GameDays & experiment tooling (Chaos Mesh/Litmus), and the resilience patterns chaos validates — each a hands-on experiment against a local kind cluster.
